page_title: LEV 2-1 EIN | Bayer Leverkusen v Eintracht Frankfurt 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Felix Brych is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.

90+4' What an amazing save by Kevin Trapp! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
90+2' Total attempts – 26:8.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
89' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
87' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Felix Brych stops the game and makes a call.
87' Eintracht Frankfurt keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
84' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
82' Substitution. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Niels Nkounkou.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) for Jeremie Frimpong.
80' Victor Boniface comes off the pitch to be replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
79' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Larsson.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) will replace Tuta.
78' The attendance for today's match is 30000.
78' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Kevin Trapp expertly pushes away.
75' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
74' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
74' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
72' 2 - 1 Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 2:1.
71' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Mario Gotze.
71' It's time for a substitution. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Junior Dina Ebimbe.
70' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
69' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
68' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
68' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Kevin Trapp.
67' What was Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
65' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
64' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Martin Terrier will be replaced by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).
64' Substitution. Amine Adli will be replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
63' POST! Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
58' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
56' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
56' Corner kick. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to send the ball into the box.
56' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
50' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort.
49' Lovely cross from Martin Terrier to find Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) deep in the box, but he steers his header well over the bar.
49' Bayer Leverkusen are seeing far more of the ball now.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Flag up against Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
45+3' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+1' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
43' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
40' The ball is cleared after Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
39' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
38' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
38' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
36' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
35' It looked like the long-range shot by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
34' Some patient build-up play from Eintracht Frankfurt as they look to unlock the defence.
31' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
31' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.
31' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
29' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
28' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
27' The free kick into the penalty area from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.

25' 1 - 1 Goal! Martin Terrier plays in Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:1.
24' A great run by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
23' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
23' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
23' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the left side of the goal that is easily dealt with by Kevin Trapp.
20' The linesman signals that Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
19' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lukas Hradecky into the bottom left corner.
16' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
16' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
15' Referee Felix Brych makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Eintracht Frankfurt. Let’s see what happens!
15' PENALTY APPEAL after Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
14' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
12' OFF THE POST! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
10' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
9' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot low into the middle of the target, but Kevin Trapp pulls off a save.
9' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
9' Referee Felix Brych is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Bayer Leverkusen!
6' Celebrations by Bayer Leverkusen are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
5' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opposition player and Felix Brych signals a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen!
5' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
4' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' What a long-range shot by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Felix Brych.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
